item.description: Common material used to craft items and sell

item.name: 6-Shooter Revolver
item.description: A classic western 6-shooter revolver. Holds 6 rounds of high-velocity ammunition.

item.name: Sol
item.description: The radiant currency of the realm. Gleaming golden coins minted from pure solar ore.

item.name: Gun Bullet
item.description: Standard brass ammunition cartridge fired by firearms.

item.name: Flame Pickaxe
item.description: A pickaxe wreathed in flame. Mines four times as fast as a basic pickaxe.

item.name: Bridge
item.description: A sturdy plank to lay across a gap. Walk on it, build with it. Mine it to take it back.

fluid.name: Oil
fluid.description: Thick black crude. Flows slowly, slows anything wading through it, and burns.

fluid.name: Lava
fluid.description: Molten rock. Creeps slowly, glows, burns anything in it, and sets hard when water reaches it.

fluid.name: Water
fluid.description: Clear, thin water. Flows fast, puts out fires and cools lava into stone.

gas.name: Hydrogen
gas.description: A very light, clear gas. It rises fast, pools under ceilings, and explodes when lit.

gas.name: Nitrogen
gas.description: A harmless, non-flammable gas, a little heavier than air here so it settles low. The test gas.

miningBlock.name: Treasure Chest

miningBlock.name: Copperium Ore

miningBlock.name: Dirt
miningBlock.description: Standard earthen ground. Easy to mine.

miningBlock.name: Mine Entrance
miningBlock.description: The ladder leading back to the surface.

miningBlock.name: Mineral Vein
miningBlock.description: Rock embedding valuable ore and crystals.

miningBlock.name: Rock
miningBlock.description: Dense, solid rock. Can fall when unsupported.

miningBlock.name: Silverium Ore
miningBlock.description: Lustrous silver ore veins glowing with concentrated subterranean energy.

miningBlock.name: Bridge
miningBlock.description: A placed bridge. Solid from every side.

miningBlock.name: Lavarock
miningBlock.description: Lava cooled solid by water. Hard, dark and slow to dig through.
